notes.title: Game size is greatly increased
notes.content:
New puzzle size
This major update has added new puzzle sizes, players will face richer levels, and at the same time, there will be greater challenges.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42011503/16104514fb7ffb4f956dcf5d1fd82ee1869f6413.png

Number prompt color
The newly added digital hint color function, these colors can better help players to complete the puzzle, making the puzzle no longer difficult.

New settings options
Players can freely set the switches of some game functions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42011503/fdbd86b1610fa32f4bfb8ee3e3359f223541c7c4.png
Autofill: Automatically remove empty rows (columns) and automatically fill full rows (columns)
Hint Colors: Displays completed, speculative, and error number color displays

Detailed update

 Added 15x15 puzzle size
 Added 25 new levels
 5 10x10
 20 15x15
Added digital prompt color function
Add setting options
 Autofill switch
 Hint color switch
Fix the problem that the mesh thickness is not obvious enough
Adjusted the level order according to the difficulty of the puzzle
